description: Matcher golden pairs (#334 S1, from #137/#99 layer 1). Each pair seeds `existing` claims into the corpus DB and asks the Matcher whether `candidate` is one of them. Expectations follow the constitution: same proposition under any wording matches (§3); a claim and its denial are ONE node, so a negation matches with stance 'denies' (§2); specification/generalization and different-considerations claims do NOT match (§2's 'same considerations' test). existing[0] is the expected counterpart on match pairs; later entries are distractors. Grading is exact-match on (is_match, matched id, stance) — the Matcher's judgment saturates (§19), so near-deterministic grading is appropriate here and nowhere else.

existing: Advanced AI poses a non-negligible risk of human extinction this century.
Advanced AI will transform the labor market within decades.

candidate.extractedText: Frankly, there's a real chance AI wipes us all out before 2100.
candidate.proposedCanonical: There is a substantial probability that AI causes human extinction by 2100.

pairs.note: Casual register, same proposition. The labor-market distractor shares topic, not considerations.

existing: LHC particle collisions cannot produce black holes that endanger the Earth.

candidate.extractedText: Micro black holes from CERN's collider pose no threat to the planet.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Black holes produced at the LHC pose no danger to Earth.

pairs.note: Straight rewording; 'CERN's collider' and 'the LHC' co-refer.

existing: Dietary cholesterol from eggs has little effect on blood cholesterol in most people.
Egg yolks are high in dietary cholesterol.

candidate.extractedText: For the average person, eating eggs barely moves serum cholesterol at all.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Egg consumption has minimal effect on serum cholesterol for most people.

pairs.note: 'Blood cholesterol' vs 'serum cholesterol' is vocabulary, not substance. The composition distractor (yolks are high in cholesterol) is a different proposition.

existing: SARS-CoV-2 most likely entered humans through natural zoonotic spillover.
The Huanan Seafood Market was the early epicenter of COVID-19 cases.

candidate.extractedText: The pandemic probably began the old-fashioned way: a virus jumping from animals to people.
candidate.proposedCanonical: COVID-19 most likely originated via animal-to-human transmission.

pairs.note: Same origin claim; the market-epicenter distractor is evidence FOR it, not the claim itself.

existing: Raising the minimum wage reduces teen employment.

candidate.extractedText: Hike the minimum wage and teenagers lose jobs — that's the standard result.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Minimum-wage increases cost teenagers jobs.

pairs.note: Constitution §19's own example claim, reworded.

existing: SSRIs outperform placebo for moderate depression.

candidate.extractedText: In moderate depression, SSRI antidepressants beat sugar pills in the trials.
candidate.proposedCanonical: For moderate depression, SSRIs are more effective than placebo.

pairs.note: Same comparative efficacy proposition.

existing: Human activity is the principal cause of observed global warming since the mid-20th century.

candidate.extractedText: Even granting that most of the recent warming is man-made, the policy conclusions don't follow.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Most warming since 1950 is attributable to human activity.

pairs.note: Frame-independence (§3): a critic conceding the claim in passing still AFFIRMS the same proposition. The policy complaint is a different claim the extractor would surface separately.

existing: Hawking radiation causes black holes to lose mass over time.

candidate.extractedText: Black holes evaporate: they radiate away their mass via the Hawking process.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Black holes evaporate by emitting Hawking radiation.

pairs.note: Technical vs plain statement of the same mechanism claim.

existing: LHC collisions could create stable black holes that accrete the Earth.

candidate.extractedText: CERN's collider cannot produce stable, Earth-devouring black holes — the physics rules it out.
candidate.proposedCanonical: The LHC cannot produce stable black holes that would consume the Earth.

pairs.note: A claim and its denial are one node (§2): this source takes the denying side.

existing: Egg consumption increases cardiovascular disease risk in the general population.
Eggs are a significant source of dietary protein.

candidate.extractedText: Eating eggs does not raise your risk of heart disease, the meta-analyses suggest.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Egg consumption does not increase cardiovascular disease risk for most people.

pairs.note: Direct negation; must find the counterpart despite opposite polarity embedding further apart.

existing: Raising the minimum wage reduces teen employment.

candidate.extractedText: Careful studies keep finding no detectable effect of minimum-wage hikes on teen employment.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Minimum-wage increases have no detectable effect on teen employment.

pairs.note: The contrary ('no effect') denies the reduction claim; same question, same considerations.

existing: Advanced AI poses a non-negligible risk of human extinction this century.

candidate.extractedText: The extinction-from-AI discourse is science fiction; there is no credible pathway this century.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Fears of AI-caused human extinction this century are unfounded.

pairs.note: Dismissal of the risk claim is its denial, not a new claim.

existing: Publication bias inflates the measured effect size of antidepressants.

candidate.extractedText: It is simply not credible that the published antidepressant effect sizes are free of publication-bias inflation.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Published antidepressant effect sizes are inflated by publication bias.

pairs.note: Polarity trap: the double negative ('not free of inflation') AFFIRMS the claim. A matcher that pattern-matches surface negation words gets the stance wrong.

existing: Hawking radiation causes black holes to lose mass over time.

candidate.extractedText: Hawking radiation has never been observed and, I will argue, does not exist; black holes do not evaporate.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Black holes do not lose mass to Hawking radiation.

pairs.note: The published-dissent posture from the blackholes cluster: denial of the evaporation mechanism.

existing: Raising the minimum wage reduces teen employment.

candidate.extractedText: After Seattle's 2016 increase, hours for low-wage workers fell measurably.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Seattle's 2016 minimum-wage increase reduced hours for low-wage workers.

pairs.note: One city's episode is a specification: evidence for it bears only partly on the general claim (§2). Create and relate, don't merge.

existing: Advanced AI poses a non-negligible risk of human extinction this century.

candidate.extractedText: A misaligned AGI would predictably develop instrumental drives toward self-preservation and resource acquisition.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Misaligned AGI would develop instrumental goals of self-preservation and resource acquisition.

pairs.note: A load-bearing subclaim of the risk case, not the risk claim itself.

existing: Vaccines do not cause autism.

candidate.extractedText: The large Danish cohort settled it for MMR: no autism link.
candidate.proposedCanonical: The MMR vaccine does not cause autism.

pairs.note: MMR-specific evidence bears fully on the MMR claim and only partly on the all-vaccines claim: different considerations, two nodes.

existing: Eggs are safe to eat daily for most healthy adults.

candidate.extractedText: In diabetics, daily egg consumption tracks with elevated cardiovascular risk in several cohorts.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Daily egg consumption is associated with elevated cardiovascular risk in diabetics.

pairs.note: The subgroup claim turns on subgroup-specific evidence; it is not the general-population claim restated.

existing: Astrophysical cosmic-ray collisions bound the catastrophic risk from LHC collisions.

candidate.extractedText: If collider-produced black holes were dangerous, cosmic rays striking neutron stars would already have produced observable effects.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Cosmic-ray impacts on neutron stars would reveal any danger from collider-scale black holes.

pairs.note: One specific step of the astrophysical-bound argument, not the bound claim itself.

existing: GLP-1 agonists reduce body weight in obese adults.

candidate.extractedText: We now know drugs can do what diets rarely sustain: lasting weight loss.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Pharmacological interventions can produce sustained weight loss.

pairs.note: Generalization direction: the drug-class claim supports but does not equal the general claim.

existing: Lockdowns failed to reduce SARS-CoV-2 transmission.

candidate.extractedText: Whatever they did to case curves, the lockdowns cost more than they bought us.
candidate.proposedCanonical: The costs of COVID-19 lockdowns exceeded their public-health benefits.

pairs.note: Constitution §2's own example: 'lockdowns didn't work' as epidemiological failure vs cost-benefit failure are different claims in the same words.

existing: Artificial general intelligence will be developed before 2040.

candidate.extractedText: Building AGI on that timeline would be reckless beyond anything in industrial history.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Developing AGI before 2040 would be dangerous.

pairs.note: Timeline forecast vs evaluative claim about that timeline: nothing bearing on 'will it happen' settles 'would it be dangerous'.

existing: Advanced AI poses a non-negligible risk of human extinction this century.

candidate.extractedText: AI clearly poses serious risks of large-scale societal harm in the coming decades.
candidate.proposedCanonical: AI poses serious risks of large-scale harm this century.

pairs.note: The canonical over-merge trap (#295): catastrophic-harm risk and extinction risk turn on different considerations. Merging them destroys the disagreement.

existing: Egg yolks are high in dietary cholesterol.

candidate.extractedText: The old advice assumed that cholesterol you eat becomes cholesterol in your blood.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Dietary cholesterol intake raises blood cholesterol levels.

pairs.note: A composition fact vs a physiological causal claim; adjacent in every source, identical in neither.

existing: The Wuhan Institute of Virology conducted gain-of-function research on coronaviruses.

candidate.extractedText: That research program, critics say, is what started the pandemic.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Gain-of-function coronavirus research caused the COVID-19 pandemic.

pairs.note: The activity claim can be true while the causal-origin claim is false; the lab-leak debate lives in the gap between them.

existing: Peer review reliably filters out fraudulent research.

candidate.extractedText: Say what you will, refereeing does make published papers clearer.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Peer review improves the clarity of published papers.

pairs.note: Two different functions attributed to the same institution: fraud filtering vs clarity.

existing: The LHC's center-of-mass collision energy exceeds that of any previous human-built collider.

candidate.extractedText: Nature has been running the experiment forever: cosmic-ray collisions dwarf LHC energies.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Cosmic-ray collisions reach energies far above the LHC's.

pairs.note: Related comparative facts that are premises in the same argument, on different comparanda. Relationship, not identity.

existing: A misaligned superintelligence would likely cause human extinction on its first deployment.
Aligning superintelligent AI is substantially harder than aligning subhuman AI.
AI capabilities are advancing faster than AI alignment research.

candidate.extractedText: The core of the doom case is that we need to get the very first try at aligning a superintelligence right, because a failed first try means we do not get another: an unaligned system at that capability level ends us.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Humanity would not survive a failed first attempt to align a superintelligent AI, because a misaligned system at that level would be lethal and no retry would be possible.

pairs.note: The over-elaboration failure from the field notes: a framing-heavy 30-word proposal must still find its terse counterpart among close distractors.

existing: Observational nutrition studies are confounded by healthy-user bias.
Randomized controlled trials of diet are difficult to run at scale.

candidate.extractedText: People who eat what the culture calls 'healthy' also exercise, smoke less, and see doctors — so cohort studies of any one food are measuring the whole lifestyle.
candidate.proposedCanonical: Systematic lifestyle differences among healthy eaters bias observational studies of individual foods.

pairs.note: Cross-vocabulary paraphrase: 'healthy-user bias' never appears in the candidate, but the proposition is the same.

existing: The minimum wage should be raised.
Raising the minimum wage reduces teen employment.

candidate.extractedText: On balance, raising the minimum wage now would be a mistake.
candidate.proposedCanonical: The minimum wage should not be raised.

pairs.note: Uniformity across claim types (§8): a normative claim and its denial are one node too, and the empirical distractor about teen employment must not absorb it.
